Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files using RSA-2014 and AES-256 algorithms
Kills tasks and services that could risk encryption process (email clients, database apps, web servers, document editors)
Excludes some directories from encryption to prevent system non-bootable state
Randomizes function names to thwart analysis
Attack Vector: Used in conjunction with Log4Shell exploit to target vulnerable machines
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note demanding 0.05 Bitcoin (~$2,150) for decryption tool
